paragraphs: Enhanced methane production and energy potential from rice straw by employing microaerobic pretreatment via anaerobic digestion
Farrukh Raza Amina,b, Habiba Khalida, Wanwu Lia, Chang Chena*, Guangqing Liua*
aCollege of Chemical Engineering, Beijing University of Chemical Technology, Beijing 100029, China.

The characterization of the final digestate was done after 50 days of AD, as a reference for methane production process stability as given in Table S1. The final pH value of the digestates of RS pretreated by all five microbial reagents was between (6.76-7.72), which was in the appropriate pH range for methane production of AD (Qin et al., 2019). After AD process the concentrations of VFAs in all digesters were lower than 41.5 mg/L. AD instability might occur as an outcome of TAN levels higher than 1500 mg/L (Li et al., 2018). In this research, however, TAN concentrations lay between 550-998 mg/L for all groups, which does not impede the methane generation process. The concentration of TA also amplified with increasing the O2 concentration in all groups. The VFAs/TA value is normally perceived as a stability index of AD process, and a value below 0.4 is ideal, hence, TVFA/TA in our study was found to be less than 0.4, indicating process stability for RS pretreatment with different microbial groups and O2 concentrations. Therefore, all the above-mentioned parameters together indicated that the methane generation process was stable, and no inhibition factor affected the AD process.

Diversity of microorganisms by using PcoA graph

According to the 16s rRNA sequencing data, we have made Graph A to compare the bacterial community similarity in different groups, as well as for archaeal community similarity (Graph B).  In graph A, we found the SD group showed long distance to BS group, indicating bacterial community of these two groups were quite different. The main reason is likely that BS was taken from anaerobic environment such as biogas digester, while SD was mainly made for aerobic degradation of stalk. In the graph B, the anaerobic pretreatment group showed relatively long distance to microaerobic and untreated groups, indicating anaerobic pretreatment resulted in unique archaeal community as compared with two other groups. What’s more, the microaerobic and untreated groups showed relatively short distance, implying there was some difference in the archaeal community of the two groups.
